description: Fills in missing translations, and redoes ones whose source text changed, in the existing locale files (JSON, YAML, .po, .arb, strings.xml, .xcstrings, .strings, messages.json). Code is not changed. Needs a localize.dev API key.

app.description: Monorepo: the app to work in (e.g. apps/web), relative to the repository root. Default: the root.

dry_run.description: Report what would change without writing files.

locales.description: Languages to translate into, creating files as needed (default: the languages already there).

name: translate
title: Fill missing translations
